payload.title: Implement all-source live fusion intake and mandatory research re-entry
payload.work_clay: Implement the owner-fixed CLAY_OMNISOURCE_LIVE_FUSION_RESEARCH_REENTRY_DIRECTIVE across current UnifiedDB/ClayGraph/work-fabric surfaces without promoting the still-candidate adaptive routing mechanism. Add provenance-bound OmniSourceObservation intake, FusionAssessment, ResearchReentryReceipt, deduplication, stale-epoch rejection, contradiction/counterevidence retention, targeted branch feedback and research-to-architecture/test/work closure. Cover repo/work/worker/runtime/benchmark/failure/negative-result/user/uploaded/external/provider/Frank-telemetry/UnifiedDB/ClayGraph/experiment source classes where an authorized current source exists. Low-relevance raw data remains indexed/pullable rather than broadcast into active context.
payload.reason_clay: The current stack already has recursive live refresh and a candidate dependency-aware routing mesh, but the project-owner direction requires a single source-coverage and research-reentry law spanning all newly observed available data. The mechanism must prove that material deltas reliably return to evidence, hypotheses, counterhypotheses, experiments, architecture, tests and work without converting raw data volume or network exposure into truth.
payload.completion_clay: A current-repo implementation and replay report shows representative events from every available source class entering provenance-bound intake; duplicate and stale inputs are handled correctly; contradictions and negative results remain recoverable; every material semantic delta produces a ResearchReentryReceipt and targeted affected-branch feedback; research results create/revise architecture/test/work or explicit NO_CHANGE; crash/restart preserves receipt closure; exact latency/resource/raw rows and metadata are recorded. Adaptive routing v2 remains CANDIDATE_NOT_PROMOTED unless its separate real-replay/recovery gate passes.
payload.executor_policy: Refresh canonical/head, current work revisions and current source availability immediately before effect. Do not displace the BASE ClayCode release critical path when the same executor is required; run with spare capacity or when the implementation directly improves current shared-state reliability. No paid training. No Frank self-harness authority. No raw-data global context flood.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed directive explicitly supersedes omnisource live fusion/research re-entry
A newer verified implementation receipt already provides equivalent all-source intake and mandatory research re-entry
Current runtime/schema evidence shows the proposed record boundary would create a second semantic authority outside Clay
